kind: supplementary source-driven monthly mechanism replication, explicitly adapted universe/execution
skill_usage: Report reproduction guidance and native extract-report for accessible OVNT PDF; standalone reviewed factor/statistic scripts, no native model trials

data.universe: 5435 instruments in frozen real OHLC source, historical SH/SZ including delisted; not complete all-A history; no BSE/new source repairs
data.prices: Same-date multiplicative vendor adjusted OHLC; volume raw shares/factor. Vendor adjustments not certified total-return/PIT vintage.
data.calendar: Frozen observed global SSE calendar; preserve every internal missing session

candidates.name: 理想振幅
candidates.source: 开源证券2020-05-16 振幅因子的隐藏结构
candidates.pages: p5 Table2 and implementation; p6 section3; p7 five groups
candidates.source_evidence: Web-read original and independent same-institution continuation; source notes hashed separately, not fake PDF hash
candidates.formula: Within last20 global exchange sessions, valid day amplitude=high/low-1; sort valid days by adjusted close; VH mean highest k amplitudes, VL lowest k; score=-(VH-VL)
candidates.valid_days: Finite positive OHLC from frozen quality source, high>low; H=L excluded as conservative one-price proxy, not verified limit-board history; at least10 valid days among fixed20, NOT last20 valid observations
candidates.k_rule: max(1,floor(.25*n_valid)); chronological stable sort resolves equal closes
candidates.direction: Higher signed score predicts higher next-month return (original V has negative sign)
candidates.sort_price_choice: Adjusted close only; raw/adjusted sorting basis not explicit in original, fixed local choice to avoid ex-right jumps; no second variant
candidates.ipo_rule: At least60 observed global exchange sessions since max(actual IPO,source calendar start), conservative local interpretation because source60days not explicitly trading/calendar
missing_original_filters: PIT industry/size and other neutralization not performed

candidates.name: 隔夜趋势12月
candidates.source: Guo, Han, Li, Li (2025) The nexus of overnight trend and asset prices in China
candidates.pages: p7 Eq3.1-3.4; p8 Eq4.1 and one-month gap; p8-9 Table1; p20-21 Table11
candidates.daily_overnight: adj_open[d]/adj_close[d-1]-1, equal to (1+adjusted total daily return)/(raw_close[d]/raw_open[d])-1 only under unified same-day factor; vendor adjusted price is local total-return proxy
candidates.monthly_overnight: Product of(1+daily overnight)-1 over ALL global sessions of the month, requiring every daily pair valid; missing full calendar month stays missing, no fill
candidates.formula: Holding month t: score=(product of(1+monthly_overnight[t-j]) for j=2..12 -1)/11; 11 complete inputs, NOT arithmetic mean
candidates.time_mapping: Form at t-1 month-end, skip t-1, use t-12..t-2. Original one-month gap resolves indexing; no extra lag. Jan2024 holding usesJan-Nov2023, skipsDec2023.
candidates.ipo_rule: At least3 calendar months; additionally11 complete historical input months needed
candidates.zero_return_filter: Exclude when all last3 completed adjusted close-to-close monthly returns at formation are exactly0; strictly past data, NaN not0
candidates.period: Earliest expected2020-02 through2026-10, at most81; first Jan2019 overnight month invalid withoutDec2018close
missing_original_filters: Bottom30% PIT total market cap exclusion
Monthly missing/suspension implementation unspecified; strict full-month convention local
FF3 matched factors unavailable, no claimed alpha reproduction

monthly_definition.formation: Month-end known signal, next natural calendar month target
monthly_definition.primary_label: Adjusted close target month end / adjusted close formation month end -1; conditional statistical association, not same-close fill
monthly_definition.open_sensitivity: First opening after formation month end to first opening after holding month end; October2026 lacksNovemberopen and is immature
monthly_definition.groups: Candidate-specific5/10 bins, score ascending then instrument; floor(rank0*bins/N)+1; N>=100; target weights fixed before labels
monthly_definition.missing_outcomes: Preserve membership; conditional means, full-weight known contribution, missing mass, complete top-group returns and -100% unknown long-only lower bound separately. Never missing=0 or outcome-based reranking.
monthly_definition.long_only: Top group vs same signal pool EW, not official market index; conditional comparison only when outcomes missing
monthly_definition.cost_convention: Target-weight absolute changes summed per leg, first entry included, no return drift. Long-short fees apply sum of two legs. Also report average two-leg turnover only for convention transparency. Original amplitude0.3% fee side ambiguity and OVNT average-leg B-E prevent like-for-like net comparison.
monthly_definition.shorting: Theoretical LS only; no assumption borrow/financing/fills feasible

inference.primary: Monthly conditional top-minus-bottom spread for both fixed candidates
inference.hac: ideal_amplitude20 lag3 local choice; ovnt12 lag12 following source; full calendar grid not compressed after missing values
inference.family: 2 one-sided mean tests Holm2, includes failed candidates
inference.support_gate: n>=24, mean>0, two-sided HAC95% lower>0, Holm2p<=.05; only adapted retrospective association, not live strategy or exact universe replication
inference.secondary: Separate Holm2 family for direct monthly RankIC; Pearson/rank ICIR, annual and2020-23/2024-25/2026 blocks, matched candidate months descriptive
inference.sensitivities: Open-label and fixed costs/long-only descriptive, never alternative winner selection
inference.paper_comparisons: Do not compare original neutral/FF3 alpha to unneutral localIC; do not equate source annualized strategy returns to conditional monthly means

budget.implementation: Reuse frozen OHLC with year chunks, old monthly endpoint table only as labels; no duplicate native prepare

stop_rule: Run these2 only; MAX/52-week-high/tail-risk not tested; no raw-vs-adjusted or6/9/15month sweep. Log implementation repairs, preserve negative results. No Site/nativefinal.
